Make a 16-bar track at 96 BPM in 4/4, in A minor. Set the tempo first. Then make four new MIDI tracks named Drums, Bass, Chords and Lead, each with a Cascade instrument (device type beatlayer.cascade, role instrument) on it. Put one MIDI clip on each track, starting at bar 1 and exactly 16 bars long (45158400 ticks), with notes all the way through bar 16. Drums: a kick on key 36 on beats 1 and 3, a snare on key 38 on beats 2 and 4, and a closed hat on key 42 on every beat. Bass: A1 (key 33) and E2 (key 40) in half notes. Chords: Am, F, C and G, one chord per bar, a whole note each, repeating through all 16 bars. Lead: a quarter-note melody in the A minor scale around key 69. Say briefly what you built when you are done.
